note: Algorithm register for every model-driven organ in BEOPS (cf. Amsterdam/Helsinki algorithm registers; EU AI Act Art. 50 transparency). An organ derives; it never measures. Everything an organ writes is state 'estimated', drawn with a structural stroke, never chromatic, and carries model id + prompt hash + organ version. A human editor of record is named for every organ whose text can reach the public.

organs.purpose: Sort headlines the collector received into a fixed topic list, say whether they concern Belgrade, and propose up to three candidate zones from the project's gazetteer, keeping every candidate with its score.
organs.inputs: headline (<=200 chars), link, publication time - never the article body (07-legal)
organs.outputs: data/live/derived/news/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl - rows of state 'estimated' with category, belgrade, zones[], event_time_text, model, prompt_sha256
organs.runs_where: on the PC body only (local model daemon at 127.0.0.1:11434); no headline leaves the machine
organs.model_role: classifier with constrained JSON output, temperature 0; no free text is produced for the public
organs.known_limits: Serbian tabloid headlines are ambiguous; the gazetteer is coarse by rule (zones, not streets); a place the model names outside the gazetteer is recorded as a rejection, never as a zone; the organ is silent when the daemon is down and says so in a receipt
organs.human_review: a weekly sample of 30 derived rows is read by the editor of record and disagreements are appended to research/08-provenance/CORRECTIONS.md
organs.ai_act_art_50: outputs are machine-marked ai_generated=true; any sentence shown to the public is labelled as model-derived; the editor of record holds editorial responsibility (Art. 50(4) exception path)
organs.status: built 2026-09-08; first run against a local model on 2026-09-09 (see receipts) ; 0.1.1 binds by echoed headline (C-013); 2026-09-09: moved to the same main model as the mind (qwen3.5:4b, Apache-2.0) - the body (8 GB RAM, 4 GB GPU) cannot hold two models, and the 500s of 10:19 UTC on the public page were the two organs evicting each other during the voice bench; 11:15 UTC: the 4b sorted five headlines in more than nine minutes (the task limit) - with fourteen feeds the sorter needs a small fast model: qwen2.5:1.5b, the Skeptic's model, already resident beside the 4b (1.0 + 3.1 GB fit the 4 GB GPU). Categorical JSON with the C-013 echo binding is a job a 1.5B model can do; its sorting is a model's estimate and is labelled so
organs.why_local_only: names ending in ':cloud' are Ollama-hosted; a headline sent there leaves the machine, which this entry forbids. Measured on the PC 2026-09-08: local qwen2.5:3b (2.0 GB), qwen3.5:0.8b, lfm2.5:1.2b, llama3.2:1b present

organs.purpose: The real monologue as a conversation, drop by drop: small local models orchestrated in layers - a program builds the digest and computes connections; organelles (a multilingual sentence-embedding model that links the same event across outlets, the smallest instruct model that rates connections by surprise) annotate it; three temperaments (Observer, Skeptic, Connector) think in English on the strongest local model and answer each other; the one model that writes Serbian renders every accepted thought; every utterance is validated by code, notebooks are read back (learning without training), claims are scored when reality arrives.
organs.inputs: public/live-snapshot.json only (receptions, silences, SEPA spreads, headlines, other organs' derived rows) rendered as numbered facts F1..Fn; the entity's own notebook; the other entities' VALIDATED utterances of the same conversation
organs.outputs: data/live/derived/mind/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl (state 'thought' or 'rejected', with entity, round, replies_to, cites, hypotheses, questions, next_check, claim, model, prompt_sha256, digest_sha256); notebook/<entity>.jsonl; claims.jsonl with outcomes; receipts/; digests/ (the exact facts each conversation saw)
organs.runs_where: on the PC body only (local model daemon at 127.0.0.1:11434); nothing leaves the machine
organs.model_role: three first-person voices with constrained JSON output (sr, en, cites, hypotheses, questions, next_check, claim), temperature 0.5; heterogeneity by family is deliberate so that a shared misconception is less likely to be shared
organs.validation_by_code: an utterance may contain only numbers present in its digest; only fact ids that exist; no prediction worded as fact (a claim has its own field and fixed shapes: reception-within-minutes, spread-lo-hi-within-minutes); refused utterances are logged as 'rejected' with reasons, are not shown to the other entities and never reach the snapshot
organs.learning: no weights change. Each entity's notebook (what it said, whether it was refused and why, how its claims scored) is read back to it at the next conversation as verbal feedback. Claims are settled by `organ_mind.py score` from later snapshots; the scoreboard (accepted/rejected/true/false per entity) is public in the snapshot and on the site
organs.known_limits: first night: llama3.2:1b and lfm2.5:1.2b produce no Serbian, so thinking is in English and one model renders Serbian (validated); the family comparison therefore starts with organelles, not with voices; small CPU: one or two model calls per 4-minute step; the embedding organelle needs 'paraphrase-multilingual' pulled into Ollama (278 MB) - until then the linker step leaves a receipt 'no embedding model' and the drip continues; claims are worth their score and nothing more; multi-agent echo is prevented by passing validated utterances only
organs.human_review: the editor of record reads a weekly sample of 30 utterances and every settled claim; disagreements are appended to research/08-provenance/CORRECTIONS.md; a human may stop the organ by creating data/live/derived/mind/PAUSED
organs.ai_act_art_50: every utterance is machine-marked ai_generated=true and shown with the entity name, the model id and the 'thought' state; nothing it says is presented as a measurement; the editor of record holds editorial responsibility
organs.status: 0.3.0 built 2026-09-09: layers, organelles, English thinking + Serbian voice, drip mode every 4 min (Beops_Mind); 0.3.5 (2026-09-09): every public word in Serbian ekavica - guard of ~300 ijekavian/Croatian stems on the thought, the hypotheses and the questions; one retry with the refusal read back; the Serbian page shows no English (a refused rendering is announced by the program in Serbian); rows voiced under the old guard are re-checked at export
organs.measured_2026_09_09: First conversation (0.2.0, 00:26 UTC): llama3.2:1b (Skeptic) returned empty or English word salad in the sr field; lfm2.5:1.2b (Connector) returned Serbian-looking word salad ('možeš da se to je ne dovolno') that PASSED validation because its cites array was well-formed while its text cited nothing - retracted, and the validator now requires inline citations, a language check and a prompt-echo check (0.2.1). qwen2.5:3b (Observer) wrote correct Serbian with every number in the digest but cited nothing inline, and its first call overran num_predict=900 (raised to 1400). Consequence on this hardware: only one local family speaks Serbian, so heterogeneity is by temperament and temperature, not by family, until a second Serbian-capable family is present (candidates to test when hardware allows: gemma3:4b, qwen2.5:7b, mistral-nemo). Recorded, not hidden: the family comparison is the experiment, and its first result is that two of three families cannot take part in Serbian. || 00:53 UTC, first drips of 0.3.1: the Skeptic and the Connector (both qwen2.5:3b) produced nearly the same sentence ('The city's maximum values of PM10 and NO2 have moved significantly...') - the convergence the literature predicts for one family; the Serbian voice passed on two of three thoughts and was refused once (citations differ) - and it leans ijekavian ('promijenile'), which the prompt asks it not to. Changes: rule 8 (do not restate the others), Skeptic moved to qwen2.5:1.5b (Apache-2.0; size heterogeneity within the one family that writes English well). || 08:38 UTC: paraphrase-multilingual pulled (768 dims); on Serbian headlines the same event scored cosine 0.725 and a different one 0.266, so the link threshold is 0.70 (register key link_threshold), not the 0.80 written before measuring. || First night of the drip (00:50-08:38 UTC, 76 drops): 37 thoughts accepted, 23 refused (29 of the reasons: a number not in the digest), 16 organelle drops, 4 claims (reception true 1, spread false 2, open 1); voice 17 rendered, 15 refused (citations changed), 5 failed (timeouts). THE FINDING: by morning all three entities were saying one sentence ('The city's maximum PM10 and NO2 values have increased significantly ... population density near Zemun TB and Ada petlja ... expected to be checked') - the echo collapse the literature predicts, produced here by three mechanisms: each read the others' last utterances, each re-read its own accepted text in its notebook, and the digest changed little between drops. 0.3.4: an utterance that restates the conversation (word-4-gram Jaccard >= 0.5 with any recent utterance) is REFUSED by code; the notebook reads back only refusals and claim outcomes, never the entity's own accepted text; the conversation context is one latest utterance per other entity; a 'NEW since you last spoke' fact lists what changed; citations are stripped before the Serbian rendering and re-appended after (they were half of the voice refusals); ijekavian is refused.
organs.mode: drip: one step every 4 minutes (linker, observer, ranker, skeptic, connector, score); `run` on demand for a whole conversation (council or relay, alternating)

organs.legal: Data: only public/live-snapshot.json (permitted sources; headline, link and time - never an article body) and public/context-*.json (layers taken with a permission capture); nothing leaves the machine; models run under the licences above and the licence of the thinking model is checked again before any commercial use (see model_licences); AI Act Art. 50: every utterance is machine-marked ai_generated=true, shown with entity, model and state 'thought', never as a measurement; editor of record named; PAUSED file stops the organ.
organs.ekavica_guard: tools/organ_mind.py `ijekavian_hits`: a tested list (long and short jat reflex after verbal prefixes, Croatian-standard lexis), word-initial so that Srbije, linije, prijem, dijeta, objekat, odjednom, sjediniti, kolovoz, travnjak and dj-for-đ pass. Measured before it existed: 18 of 18 'voiced' sentences of the first night carried ijekavian or Croatian words (vrijednost, promijenile, utjecaj, vjerojatnost, sugerira). A list misses what is not on it; the editor's weekly sample is the second guard.
organs.voice_bench_2026_09_09: qwen3.5:4b (Apache-2.0, pulled 2026-09-09) rendered one real thought in correct, natural ekavica on the first attempt ('Maksimalne vrednosti PM10 i NO2 u gradu su se povećale sa 85 na 119 µg/m³ ...') - the first Serbian sentence of the project a Serbian reader would not correct. The bench then timed out twice; the diagnosis (runtime/ollama_diag.py, same day): with think=false the model answers 28 tokens in 3.6 s warm on the RX 580 (7.8 tok/s), cold load 84 s; with thinking left on it spends all 600 tokens thinking and returns empty content - exactly the empty fields the bench saw; and the body has 8 GB RAM with a 4 GB GPU, so two resident models (qwen2.5:3b + qwen3.5:4b) thrash. Decision: ONE main model - qwen3.5:4b thinks (Observer, Connector) and voices; the Skeptic stays on qwen2.5:1.5b for heterogeneity; the voice bench command remains for the next model. qwen2.5:3b (non-commercial) leaves the default chain.
organs.hardware_2026_09_09: i7-7700K (4 cores), 8 GB RAM, Radeon RX 580 4 GB; Ollama runs the 4b at 100% GPU with num_ctx 2048; at 6144 part of the cache spills - measure the step time in the receipts

organs.purpose: Flag unusual movements in a measured series as ESTIMATES (dashed stroke) using a small local time-series model (candidates in Svemir registry: ibm-granite/granite-timeseries-ttm-r3, amazon/chronos-bolt-tiny, AutonLab/MOMENT-1-small) - never to fill a gap, never to replace a value.
organs.inputs: data/live/rows/<sid>/*.jsonl numeric rows with known phenomenonTime
organs.outputs: data/live/derived/series/<YYYY-MM>.jsonl - estimated rows with expected range and the observation that fell outside it
organs.runs_where: PC body, onnxruntime (already installed in Svemir)
organs.known_limits: one week of rows is needed before any range means anything; imputation is forbidden by rule (contra Ferrer-Cid et al. 2025 mainstream)

organs.purpose: Once a day, write the sentence of the day - 'this is what Belgrade told us, when, and where it went quiet' - from the collector's status and the derived rows, in Serbian and English, labelled as model-written, for the editor to accept or strike before it is shown.
organs.inputs: tools/collect_daemon.py status + derived rows; never raw article text
organs.outputs: research/observations/live/VOICE_<day>.md with ai_generated=true front matter and an 'accepted_by' line that stays empty until a person fills it
organs.runs_where: PC body, local model; a cloud model may be used only with the same labelling and only for text, never for numbers
organs.known_limits: must not state any number that is not in status/derived rows verbatim; a test compares every number in the text against its sources
